verses.mystical_translation: The the Living Presence is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He makes me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
He restoreth my whole being: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
Even though I walk through a valley of deep darkness, I fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff comfort me.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the the Living Presence for ever.

contemplative_note: Guidance does not remove the valley; presence changes how the valley is crossed.
safety_note: Comfort poetry is not a promise that faithful people will avoid danger, illness, grief, or death.
